sources.citation: Mandenkan (Bulletin d'études linguistiques mandé), nos. 1-73 (1981-2026): LLACAN full article list and OpenEdition 'index des langues'.
Vydrin, V. F. 2017. Mande jazyki [The Mande languages]. In V. F. Vydrin et al. (eds.), Jazyki mira: Jazyki mande, 16-45. St Petersburg: Nestor-Istorija.
sources.note: p.19 lists bon/bolón among the Marka-Dafin idioms, which differ from Bamana/Jula in phonology, 'in particular tonal inversion is characteristic of them'; the volume has no Bolon chapter and says nothing about Bolon stress.

sources.citation: Harrison, Byron & Annette Harrison (survey with A.-M. Giminez, B. Tiendrébéogo, Z. Traoré). 2001. Sociolinguistic survey report for the Maraka-Jula ethnic group. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2001-003. 27 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey (the only SIL item tagged Bolon [bof] in the 2015 sil.org listing); compares wordlists with three Bolon villages (Dana, Tigan, Siri: 63-72% similarity); no phonology. Its bibliography names the Bolon descriptive sources: Zoungrana 1987, Jaquinod & Prost 1958, Groff & Solomiac 1983 (unpublished SIL survey).

sources.citation: Harrison, Annette R., Byron L. Harrison, Béatrice Tiendrébéogo Konfe & Stuart D. Showalter. 2022. Sociolinguistic survey report for the Bolon language. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2022-016. v + 59 pp. Dallas: SIL International.

tone.quote: For his doctoral studies at the University of the Sorbonne (Paris III), Zoungrana (1987) wrote a brief description of Bolon phonology and grammar. [...] We know of no other linguistic work in the Bolon language. There are no known materials published in Bolon. [Appendix B.1:] The symbols for phonetic transcription used in this document are in accordance with the standards of the International Phonetic Association (IPA). [B.3 Wordlist data:] 001 personne [mūɡɔ̀] Siri [mūɡǒː] N'Dana [mōɣō] Tigan [...] 003 homme [kìɛ́] Siri [ʃɛ̌] N'Dana [cɛ́ò] Tigan
tone.locator: sec. 2.9 'Linguistic work in the language area', p. 6; Appendix B.1 p. 21 and B.3 p. 22
tone.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
